formula_qini_area_auuc: area between the incremental-conversions curve and the random line (unnormalised; qini.qini_coefficient == AUQC - AUQC(random))
causal_forest_definition: hand-rolled DR-learner forest (sklearn RandomForestRegressor on DR pseudo-outcomes, cross-fitted on the committed folds; no grf/econml, per DESIGN.md no-heavyweight-deps)
t_two_model_note: the two-model approach and the T-learner are the same estimator family; one committed OOF column carries both labels
